I'm your host, Darren Van Dam!

Netflix added some Epic movies this month including The Prestige and Ad Astra alongside a batch of horror flicks like Hush, Evil Dead and Dracula. It may not be the biggest month for Netflix but there are more quality movies on Netflix this month than usual. A lot more.

If you often spend too long looking for good stuff to watch on Netflix, this list is guaranteed to have something worth your time. Most of these titles were added in early October but be on the lookout for Gladiator and Gladiator II (on Netflix for the first time!) expected Oct. 21st!
